title: 20260518 - Learning AI the Way I Learned NAV

chapters.title: The Pedro Pascal moment - learning NAV through observation
From privacy-first to all-in with AI
The skimming problem and AI journey
Tool selection and the Rome crossroads moment
Working with AI: from doer to director
The replacement ladder and director role
Marathons over chats - working with AI as a partner
Q&A - tools and deep learning approaches

features.name: AI as development partner
features.description: Using AI tools like ChatGPT with full context and real project details to accelerate Business Central development work. Changing from theoretical questions to real problem-solving with actual company and project information.
caveats: Effectiveness depends on quality of context provided

features.name: Deep learning methodology for complex systems
features.description: Comprehensive study of system documentation rather than surface-level scanning. Reading all 400 pages of technical documentation to develop mastery of NAV and Business Central systems.

features.name: ChatGPT
features.description: AI tool used for recruiting, SOPs, interview scripts, internal documentation, website copywriting, company strategy, and daily planning. Presenter started with version 3.5, then 3.5 Turbo before getting serious with GPT-4 in May 2024.
caveats: Requires clear context and structured prompts
Error patterns dependent on platform differences

features.name: Claude Desktop
features.description: AI tool that supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration with personal tools like Obsidian vault and Airtable. Presenter started testing it in late 2024 and found it different from ChatGPT.

features.name: Claude Code
features.description: Research preview feature that handles code generation and infrastructure deployment. Presenter used it as main developer partner for full-stack projects including back-end, database, and cloud deployment.
features.status_evidence_quote: Claude Code came out as a research preview, which took things to a whole new level

features.name: MCP Protocol
features.description: Model Context Protocol by Anthropic that enables Claude to connect to external tools like Obsidian vault and Airtable, creating integrated workflow capabilities.

features.name: Code review agent pattern
features.description: Using AI to spawn a code review agent that audits another AI's work, specifically looking for cross-platform issues, edge cases, and typical AI mistakes. The director sets the direction and standard while the AI reviews itself.
caveats: requires manual verification of final output
depends on clear direction and standards from user

features.name: Business Central print layout skill
features.description: An AI skill that allows users to design and build Business Central print layouts like invoices and quotes. Users provide a PDF mockup with brand colors, column structures, and fonts, and the AI generates the layout with automatic field mapping and measurement to the millimeter, eliminating manual Word and XML editing.
caveats: requires clear PDF mockup as input
still requires final verification by user before deployment

features.name: Marathon conversation technique
features.description: A methodology for working with AI where instead of asking one-off questions, users open a single sustained conversation, explain the full task and its context, define what a good result looks like, and work through it end-to-end as a partner. This produces better results than fragmented question-answer exchanges.
caveats: requires discipline to maintain focus in one conversation
not suitable for isolated quick questions

features.name: Meta prompting
features.description: Asking AI to help write better prompts that produce better outputs. The day you ask AI to help improve your prompts is when everything becomes more efficient.

features.name: AI director mindset
features.description: Shift from treating AI as a search engine to treating it as a co-worker who needs context. Requires explaining business context, not just chatting. Role is to direct, set standards, review output, and ship work.

features.name: Orchestrator for knowledge management
features.description: Personal project building an orchestrator on top of Obsidian vault that uses AI agents from Claude, OpenAI, and local models to provide insights that couldn't be obtained alone. Uses multiple AI models to identify divergent viewpoints for breakthroughs.
caveats: Personal garage project, not a product
Uses Open Claw orchestrator with multiple AI providers

features.name: 90-day deep learning methodology
features.description: Framework where you pick one tool and go deep into it for 90 days. All roads lead to Rome - the pattern is the same regardless of tool choice. Skills are transferable across different tools.
